Medicinal plant extract sold in the market claimed to have immunomodulatory activity. Septilin is a Hindu traditionally formulated medicine produced in India. It is a polyherbal drug. A preclinical test on Septilin by cyclophosphamide-induced immunosuppressed mice confirms its immunomodulatory activity [48].
